name: Red (Taylor's Version)
llm_description: Red (Taylor's Version) is Taylor Swift's re-recording of her 2012 album, continuing her masters reclamation project, featuring the original tracks plus From the Vault additions including the long-awaited 10-minute version of All Too Well.
llm_emotion_analysis: Bittersweet and intense; re-experienced heartbreak and passion with added closure, nostalgia, and the emotional catharsis of the extended All Too Well.
llm_overall_public_reception: Critically acclaimed and record-breaking; the 10 Minute Version of All Too Well was hailed as a career highlight, and the album topped charts globally.
